note: Presentation only (not game data; not part of content_hash). Files: assets/art/{units,bg,fx,map,icons}/ from tools/import_art.py, else assets/art/placeholder/. 'placeholder': true = no owner art imported yet (import_art.py keeps this flag up to date). scale is relative to a 1.0 human; y_offset is in sprite pixels at scale 1 (negative = up). 'alias' reuses another entry; 'flip': true mirrors a source that faces lower-right on import. M3c: 'map', 'map_icons', 'weapon_fx', 'weapon_icons' have no placeholder art: while 'placeholder' is true ArtRegistry returns null and the caller draws its procedural fallback.
